description: Source code implementing threading utilities for the Battle for Wesnoth project, including thread management, synchronization primitives, and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: threading::manager
classes.description: Manages thread lifecycle, particularly waiting for detached threads to finish.

classes.name: threading::thread
classes.description: Encapsulates thread creation, joining, killing, and detaching using SDL threads.

classes.name: threading::mutex
classes.description: Provides mutual exclusion using SDL mutexes.

classes.name: threading::lock
classes.description: RAII lock for mutexes, ensuring mutex is released when lock object is destroyed.

classes.name: threading::condition
classes.description: Synchronization primitive for thread waiting and notification using SDL condition variables.

classes.name: threading::async_operation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous operation with execution, notification, and control flow.

methods.name: run_async_operation
methods.description: Function executed in a separate thread to run an async operation and handle its cleanup.

methods.name: manager::~manager
methods.description: Destructor that waits for all detached threads to complete.

methods.name: thread::thread
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new thread with a function and data.

methods.name: thread::~thread
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if still running.

methods.name: thread::kill
methods.description: Terminates the thread if it is running.

methods.name: thread::join
methods.description: Waits for the thread to finish execution.

methods.name: thread::detach
methods.description: Detaches the thread, allowing it to run independently.

methods.name: condition::wait
methods.description: Waits on the condition variable with a mutex.

methods.name: condition::wait_timeout
methods.description: Waits with a timeout on the condition variable.

methods.name: condition::notify_one
methods.description: Signals one thread waiting on the condition.

methods.name: condition::notify_all
methods.description: Broadcasts to all threads waiting on the condition.

methods.name: async_operation::notify_finished
methods.description: Marks the async operation as finished and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: async_operation::execute
methods.description: Executes the async operation in a thread, handling synchronization and control flow.
